items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: Hubert Rostand, my friend, and Combelle

ctx.x: For my own personal reasons, you see, I said, 'I think I'll take Chez Florence's.'
So, there were quite a few of us trying to get the same job at Chez Florence's. Hubert Rostand, my friend, and Combelle --
